sentences.text: Respond  Through: Mr. Jahangir Iqbal Ganai, Sr. Advocate with  Ms. Syed Goussia, Advocate  CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VINOD CHATTERJI KOUL-JUDGE  ORDER 16.12.2025 Objections have already been filed to the application seeking extension of time to condone the delay for filing the Appeal.
Grounds taken in the application are being objected more particularly on the ground that there is no explanation of delay from 07th May, 2024 to 23rd January, 2025.
Learned counsel for the respondents submits that since the delay of about seven months have not been explained, therefore, there is no ground to condone the delay.

However, Mr. H. Aman Ali, Dy.
AG seeks adjournment on the ground that he is not having the copy of the objections, therefore, he would not be in a position to assist the Court today.
Though counsel for the respondents has already provided the copy of the objections to counsel for the respondents.
He may provide one more copy to him.

"Imtiyaz"
